description: This file defines a Catalyst controller class for handling recipe import functionality, including actions for initializing import, previewing imported recipes, and submitting import data.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Recipe::Import
classes.description: A Catalyst controller class managing recipe import workflows, including initializing import, previewing, and finalizing import actions.

methods.name: base
methods.description: Chained action that initializes the import process by loading the recipe and setting up the importer object.

methods.name: preview
methods.description: Handles the preview of the imported recipe, including building a fast lookup for article units and generating a new recipe name if conflicts exist.

methods.name: post
methods.description: Processes the submitted import form, checks for duplicate recipe names, gathers ingredient data, and performs the import operation.
